ISO-M485 Isolated RS-485

ISO-M485 adalah isolator & repeater RS-485 industri dengan proteksi surge built-in. Melindungi jaringan Modbus dari ground loop, noise listrik, dan petir induksi di pabrik manufaktur, shipyard, dan plant otomatis.

RS-485 Isolation ModuleSKU: ISO-M485

ISO-M485 SERIES

Aplikasi

Di mana ISO-M485 digunakan

SCADA Networks PLC Field Bus Modbus RTU Networks Industrial Sensors Energy Monitoring Solar PV Strings Maritim Comm Substation Telemetry
Komunikasi RS-485 Andal, Diperkuat dengan Isolasi & Proteksi Surge

Saat operasi Anda bergantung pada fast, stable, and secure data communication, you can’t afford downtime or interference. ISO-M485 Series dirancang untuk koneksi RS-485 industrial-grade dengan galvanic isolation built-in dan proteksi surge yang kokoh, memastikan reliability maksimal di lingkungan paling demanding.

Tingkatkan Komunikasi Anda. Lindungi Investasi Anda.
Dengan ISO-M485 Series, Anda mendapatkan kecepatan, stabilitas, dan proteksi dalam satu device kompak dan andal.

Fitur Utama

Mengapa engineer memilih ISO-M485

01

2.5kV Optical Isolation

Optocoupler isolation between RS-485 ports protects upstream PLC/SCADA from ground loops and field-side faults.

02

Proteksi Surge Built-in

Integrated TVS diodes + gas discharge tubes guard against lightning-induced and switching transients on outdoor cables.

03

256 Device Per Bus

Extended driver capacity mendukung up to 256 nodes per segment. Auto direction control simplifies wiring.

04

Rentang Suhu Industri

-40°C to +85°C operation. DIN rail mountable. Rated untuk continuous operation in harsh field cabinets.

05

Input Daya Lebar Fleksibel

Accepts 7-15VDC or 9-24VDC supply variants for easy integration with industrial 12V or 24V control panels.

06

Data Rate Kecepatan Tinggi

Supports up to 500 kbps data rate (within distance limits) for high-throughput SCADA and PLC networks.

Pesan di Tokopedia → Unduh Datasheet
FAQ

ISO-M485 | Pertanyaan Umum

Tegangan isolasi apa yang disediakan ISO-M485?
2.5kV optocoupler isolation between RS-485 ports protects upstream PLC/SCADA equipment from ground loops, common-mode noise, and field-side faults. Galvanic isolation prevents damaging currents from propagating to your control room.
Berapa banyak device per bus RS-485?
Up to 256 nodes per segment with the extended driver capacity. Standard RS-485 mendukung 32 devices - ISO-M485's 1/8 unit-load driver memungkinkan 8× larger networks without needing repeaters.
Berapa rentang suhu operasi?
-40°C to +85°C continuous operation. Dirancang untuk harsh field cabinets, outdoor enclosures, and unconditioned spaces typical in industrial and utility deployments.
Apakah termasuk proteksi surge built-in?
Ya. Integrated TVS diodes and gas discharge tubes guard against lightning-induced and switching transients on outdoor cables. Tidak external SPD required for moderate exposure environments.
